questions.scenario_zh: 周五傍晚刚下班，最想做的是？
questions.scenario_en: It's Friday at 6pm, you just finished work — what do you most want to do?
options_zh: 独自去能出汗的地方把这周憋着的火发泄掉
打开笔记本，把对方说的每一点逐条写下反驳提纲
立刻打车过去，先骂那个伤害朋友的人一顿再谈别的
options_en: Find somewhere you can sweat out the anger you've been carrying all week
Open your notes and write a point-by-point rebuttal outline
Get in a car right now — yell at whoever hurt them before anything else

questions.scenario_zh: 最好的朋友凌晨两点哭着打电话来，说刚被分手。你的第一反应是？
questions.scenario_en: Your closest friend calls you at 2am, crying — they just got dumped. What's your first move?
options_zh: 在电话里沉默很久，然后说我在，明天一早到你家
先问清时间线、证据、谁说了什么，再列接下来 48 小时要做的事
讲一个特别烂的冷笑话，逼对方笑一下，再订早餐外卖
options_en: Stay on the line in silence, then say I'm here — at your door first thing
Ask for timeline and who's involved — list the next 48 hours
Tell an awful joke for one laugh, then order breakfast

questions.scenario_zh: 会议上你的方案被领导当众说"逻辑不通"，你的反应是？
questions.scenario_en: In a meeting, your boss publicly says your proposal 'doesn't make logical sense.' Your reaction?
options_zh: 当场开始逐条辩护，哪怕会议室已经尴尬到极点
表面点头，心里记下下次汇报前多准备三套数据
冷笑一声，之后再也不在这个人面前暴露真实想法
options_en: Defend point by point right there — even when the room is painful
Nod on the surface, note to bring three backup data sets next time
One cold laugh, then never show this person your real thinking

questions.scenario_zh: 你突然收到一笔 5 万块的意外奖金，第一反应是？
questions.scenario_en: An unexpected bonus drops into your account. What's your gut move?
options_zh: 大半存起来，留一小部分请最铁的两个人吃顿好的
立刻做表格：还债、储蓄、学习基金各占多少
先给最需要的人转一笔，再给自己买一样一直舍不得的东西
options_en: Put most away, small slice for your two closest people
Spreadsheet: debt, savings, learning fund — fixed percentages
Transfer to whoever needs it most, then one thing you've denied yourself

questions.scenario_zh: 第一次约会，你倾向于怎么安排？
questions.scenario_en: First date — how do you want to set it up?
options_zh: 选能认真说话的地方，看对方愿不愿意听你把话说完
轻松的小馆子，边吃边观察对方会不会照顾你的节奏
去一个有点奇怪、人少的地方，发生什么算什么
options_en: Somewhere you can actually talk — see if they'll listen until you finish
Casual spot — watch whether they match your pace
Some odd quiet place — whatever happens, happens

questions.scenario_zh: 室友把你冰箱里准备明天招待客人的食材提前吃掉了。你的反应是？
questions.scenario_en: Your roommate ate the food you were saving in the fridge for tomorrow's guests. Your reaction?
options_zh: 嘴上说没事，心里把冰箱分层贴条，并记下这次
当场讽刺一句，然后要求对方明天补一份回来
平静问一句为什么，再一起定共享区规则
options_en: Say it's fine, label fridge zones, file the incident
One sarcastic line, demand they replace it tomorrow
Ask calmly why, then co-write shared-zone rules

questions.scenario_zh: 派对上你被介绍给一个看起来很有趣的陌生人，你的开场是？
questions.scenario_en: At a party, you get introduced to someone who looks interesting. Your opener?
options_zh: 问对方最近在读什么，然后认真听完全部
把对方拉去认识你最熟的那一圈人
轻声说，你有没有觉得有些人其实一直在看着我们
options_en: Ask what they've been reading — listen to all of it
Drag them to introduce them to your inner circle
Softly: do you feel some people have been watching us

questions.scenario_zh: 最好的朋友突然出大事，半夜来找你帮忙。你的第一反应是？
questions.scenario_en: Your best friend hits a sudden crisis and shows up at your door at midnight. First move?
options_zh: 让对方今晚就睡你家沙发，你先扛明天要打的电话
一起把局面画在纸上，标出谁能帮、下一步是什么
只说我见过更糟的你会走出来，然后泡一杯热的
options_en: Couch tonight — you'll make the hard calls tomorrow
Map on paper — who can help, step one
I've seen worse — you'll walk out, and something hot

questions.scenario_zh: 你最讨厌的人意外升职了。你心里的第一反应是？
questions.scenario_en: Someone you can't stand just got promoted. Your first internal reaction?
options_zh: 当晚就整理材料，准备把标准是否一致问清楚
耸肩，他的路他的，我今晚照样看球
觉得也许对方有你看不见的苦，先不浪费情绪
options_en: Gather material that night to ask if standards were consistent
Shrug — their path, my game tonight
Maybe they carry something you never saw — don't spend emotion

questions.scenario_zh: 想象十年后的自己，你最希望的画面是？
questions.scenario_en: Picture yourself ten years from now — what's the version you most hope for?
options_zh: 终于不再被过去追着跑，身边有敢托付的人
成为那个想都不用想就知道该怎么做的人
还能开玩笑，但玩笑里不再有刺
options_en: Not chased by the past, with people you can trust
Someone who knows what to do without thinking
Still joking, but jokes no longer have barbs

questions.scenario_zh: 凌晨三点你毫无征兆地醒了，再也睡不着。你最可能做什么？
questions.scenario_en: It's 3am and you're suddenly wide awake. Most likely move?
options_zh: 起来把一直没敢回的消息写完
重排书架、列明天清单，用秩序换安心
泡热饮、放老歌，等身体自己再睡过去
options_en: Send the messages you've been avoiding
Re-shelve, time-block tomorrow — order for calm
Hot drink, old music, let sleep return

questions.scenario_zh: 朋友做了件不光彩的小事，求你在被问到时帮对方圆一下。你的反应是？
questions.scenario_en: A friend did something slightly off and asks you to cover for them if asked. Your reaction?
options_zh: 拒绝撒谎，但陪对方想一个不伤害第三方的说法
可以帮圆，但对方得先承认自己做错了什么
不帮圆谎，愿意陪对方去面对后果
options_en: Refuse to lie, help words that don't harm a third party
Cover only if they admit exactly what they did
Won't cover — stand beside them through consequences
